# Tile

Tile: a small square frame that holds a logo, thumbnail or icon standing for a thing.

**Import:** `import { Tile } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/images-and-icons/Tile/Tile.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/images-and-icons/Tile/Tile.stories.jsx` — Sizes, DefaultSize, IconSubtle, IconBold, Logos, LogoDefaultsToWhite, Images, WithBorder, Decorative, Labeled, Interactive, Rest

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/images-and-icons/Tile/Tile.mdx`

## Usage

Use `Tile` wherever a small square picture stands for a thing: a tool's logo in
a list of integrations, a school's crest beside its name, a lesson's thumbnail,
or an icon marking the kind of item in a row. Putting all of them in one frame
keeps them the same size and shape wherever they appear.

Use an icon on its own when it sits inline with text and needs no frame. Use
`UserAvatar` for a person: people are round, and a tile is square.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Label a tile that stands alone with the thing it shows: "Khan Academy". | "Logo" or "Icon", which names the picture. |
| Leave the label off a tile beside its name. | Repeat the name in both places. |

## Best practices

### Pick the content, then the color. {#pick-the-content-then-the-color}

Icons take `appearance` and `color`. Logos take a ground color only, since the
logo keeps its own. Images cover the whole tile, so color does not apply.

Do: Icons take appearance and color; logos keep their own.
Don't: A bold appearance on a logo, which does nothing.

### Colors are categories. {#colors-are-categories}

`color` takes the Tag color set: plain names, never a status. Keep one color per kind of
item across the app, or leave tiles gray.

Do: One color for each kind of item, across the app.
Don't: The same kind of item in two colors.

### Give a logo its own ground. {#give-a-logo-its-own-ground}

Logos default to white. Set a ground color only to match a surface; never recolor the logo.

Do: A logo on the default white ground.
Don't: A bold ground on the logo, which keeps its own.

## Accessibility

- **Decorative by default.** A tile usually sits beside a name that already
  says what it is, so it is hidden from assistive technology
  (`aria-hidden="true"`) unless it has a `label`.
- **`label` makes it one image with a name.** The tile becomes `role="img"`
  with that name, and the picture inside it stays hidden, so the square is
  announced once. Give a tile a label whenever it stands alone, such as a
  logo with no name beside it.
- **Not a control.** A tile has no hover or focus state. To make one clickable,
  wrap it in a button or link that carries the accessible name.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `content` | enum | `'icon'` | What the tile frames. Icons and logos are inset; an image fills and crops. |
| `size` | enum | `32` | 16, 20, 24, 32, 40 or 48, for every kind of content. |
| `appearance` | enum | `'subtle'` | Icons only. `subtle` is the color's container; `bold` is the solid color. |
| `color` | enum | — | A category color from the Tag set. `white` is for logos. Defaults to white for a logo, gray otherwise. |
| `icon` | string or node | — | `icon` only: a Font Awesome Free name (`book-open`), a class list, or a node. |
| `src` | string | — | `logo` or `image`: the picture's URL. |
| `children` | node | — | `logo` or `image`: the picture as a node, in place of `src`. |
| `hasBorder` | bool | `false` | Adds a 1px border inside the tile. |
| `label` | string | — | Makes the tile an image with this name. Without it the tile is decorative and hidden. |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |

## Variants

**`content`** — `icon` · `logo` · `image`

**`size`** — `16` · `20` · `24` · `32` · `40` · `48`

**`appearance`** — `subtle` · `bold`

**`color`** — `gray` · `blue` · `green` · `purple` · `magenta` · `yellow` · `teal` · `white`

Anything not listed is not a valid value.
